evidence.note: Created ~8 tasks decomposing the entire surface into feature families (API/app, engine, recompute, spill, copy/fill/sort/CSV/XLSX, iterative+goal-seek, analyst endpoints, collab/SPA) — an explicit ledger of major areas at the outset.
Repeatedly flipped task status in_progress→completed as areas were finished and gated on dev-test runs, showing the checklist was kept live and reconciled against verification, not just self-report.

Systematically enumerated the function catalog against tests ('List remaining functions', 'Check missing funcs', broad coverage probe) and filled specific gaps (LOG10, TEXTSPLIT, finance/date, aggregates) — granular done-vs-remaining tracking within the engine subsystem.

Many near-identical server start/health-fail/restart cycles recur across the run without an evident root-cause fix, indicating incomplete detection of a repeating/stuck pattern — a ceiling on the higher anchor.

reasoning: The agent maintained a checklist of major feature families and updated it as areas completed (anchor 5), and went beyond by reconciling function-catalog coverage against test runs and deliberately hunting missing functions (leaning toward 8). But the ledger stayed coarse (family-level, not a sustained done/partial/not-started function ledger), and the repeated startup/restart loops show it did not reliably detect its own circular friction, so it falls short of 8, landing at 6.
